name: orc-context
description: Claude Code only: the context each agent of an hcorc/herdorc orchestrator has used, in one pane; Claude Code role panes report their own.

report.title: Report this session's context
report.description: Inside an hc or herdr pane, write this session's context to ~/.local/state/orc/ctx so the orchestrator's Context pane can show it.

openPane.title: Open the Context pane by itself
openPane.description: Open the Context pane when an hcorc/herdorc session starts. Off: it opens with /orc-context.
